_comment: [OPUS-4.8] sq-gum8 — paper-bound EVIDENCE for the academic paper factory. Distinct from benchmarks.generated.json (which is per-commit TIMING, all environment=indicative on the dev work-box). Every record here is a DETERMINISTIC, machine-INDEPENDENT metric (recall floor / answer-safety invariant / cost-model crossover / conformance ratchet floor) lifted from a real test or the central conformance scoreboard, so environment=canonical. The honesty gate in scripts/build-papers.mjs FAILS the build if a paper-bound headline table references an environment=indicative record. To add a number a paper may cite as a headline, it MUST appear here as environment=canonical and trace to a named test or const (the `source` field).

filtered_ann.recall_at_10_floor.note: Asserted floor: filtered-traversal recall@10 vs the EXACT-filtered ground truth (nearest_exact_filtered) is gated >= 0.90 on a 20k synthetic set under a ~50% mask. Machine-independent (a deterministic seed + an assertion threshold), not a timing.

ann.recall_at_10_floor.note: Asserted floor: unfiltered HNSW recall@10 vs exact brute force is gated >= 0.95 on a 50k random set. The underlying ANN machinery is unmodified prior art; this floor bounds the approximation the filter operates over.

filtered_ann.prefilter_equals_postfilter.note: Proven by assert_eq: the filtered top-k is byte-identical (same ids, same order) to post-filtering the unfiltered top-k by the same BGP constraint, and is a subset of the unfiltered top-k. This is the answer-safety claim: pre-filtering narrows, never widens, and never changes the answer.

filtered_ann.transitive_equals_postfilte.note: A multi-hop constraint (?node :owns ?x . ?x a :Vehicle) restricts ?node to the projection of the join-connected sub-BGP and matches post-filtering the unfiltered top-k by that same transitive constraint; a disconnected pattern does not affect the mask.

filtered_ann.cyclic_equals_postfilter.note: Connected-component mask derivation terminates (fixpoint worklist) and stays answer-equal to post-filter even when the constraining sub-BGP contains a cycle (?node :owns ?x . ?x :ownedBy ?node).

filtered_ann.prefilter_crossover.note: Deterministic decision rule (not a measured latency): pre-filter is chosen iff m*scatter_penalty <= n, i.e. with the default scatter_penalty 2.0, iff the mask admits <= half the store. Whichever branch is picked the returned top-k is identical, so a mis-estimate costs throughput, never correctness.

conformance.geosparql_topology_floor.note: OGC GeoSPARQL topology compliance ratchet floor: a monotone lower bound on passing sf/eh/rcc8 topology + WKT/GML equivalence assertions that CI enforces and that may only RISE. Deterministic and machine-independent (a const a test asserts), not a timing.

conformance.sparql_floor.source: crates/sparq-conformance/src/scoreboard.rs::SUITES (W3C SPARQL row); enforced by ci.yml job conformance (RATCHET=1229)
conformance.sparql_floor.note: W3C SPARQL 1.0/1.1/1.2 query+update+syntax ratchet floor (pass + documented divergence). Deterministic; CI-enforced; may only rise.

conformance.inference_floor.source: crates/sparq-conformance/src/scoreboard.rs::SUITES (inference row); enforced by ci.yml job inference-conformance (RATCHET=1967)
conformance.inference_floor.note: Inference (rdf-mt / OWL 2 RL / N3 / entailment / rdf-turtle) ratchet floor (pass + documented divergence). Deterministic; CI-enforced; may only rise.

conformance.shacl_core_floor.note: W3C SHACL core (data-shapes sht:Validate) ratchet floor. Deterministic; CI-enforced; may only rise.

conformance.shacl_sparql_floor.note: W3C SHACL-SPARQL (sh:sparql node + property constraint sub-suites) ratchet floor. Deterministic; CI-enforced; may only rise.

conformance.solid_wac_floor.note: Solid Web Access Control (WAC) library-level decision-parity ratchet floor: a monotone lower bound on the number of minimal per-construct .acl scenarios whose (agent, client, mode, resource) allow/deny decisions all match the WAC spec semantics, run through materialize_wac + AuthIndex::accessible. Deterministic and machine-independent (a const a test asserts over a fixed scenario table), not a timing; CI-enforced; may only rise.

conformance.solid_acp_floor.note: Solid Access Control Policy (ACP) library-level decision-parity ratchet floor: a monotone lower bound on the number of minimal per-construct ACR scenarios whose (agent, client, mode, resource) allow/deny decisions all match the ACP spec semantics, run through materialize_acp + AuthIndex::accessible. Deterministic and machine-independent (a const a test asserts over a fixed scenario table), not a timing; CI-enforced; may only rise.

conformance.cross_family_total.source: crates/sparq-conformance/src/scoreboard.rs::SUITES (sum of all ratchet_floor; rendered by render_scoreboard as the total row)
conformance.cross_family_total.note: Sum of the seven cross-family conformance ratchet floors (SPARQL 1229 + inference 1967 + SHACL core 98 + SHACL-SPARQL 5 + GeoSPARQL 119 + Solid WAC 12 + Solid ACP 12). A single deterministic, CI-enforced, monotone index across crates. If any individual floor rises this total must be updated in lock-step (the same scoreboard const is the source). Updated from the prior 3418 / 5-suite value after the Solid WAC + ACP decision-parity ratchets (sq-j174) joined the central scoreboard.

conformance.suite_count.note: Number of distinct conformance suites the central scoreboard registers and ratchets across crates (W3C SPARQL, inference, SHACL core, SHACL-SPARQL, OGC GeoSPARQL, Solid WAC decision parity, Solid ACP decision parity).

memsafety.unsafe_sites_total.source: bench/unsafe-snapshot.json::total (enforced by scripts/unsafe-gate.py --check; CI job 'unsafe-register (count ratchet)' in .github/workflows/ci.yml; per-site rows in compliance/memsafety/unsafe-register.md)
memsafety.unsafe_sites_total.note: Total first-party unsafe sites across the whole crates/ workspace, as counted by a deterministic comment-/string-stripped keyword scan (scripts/unsafe-gate.py). This is a CI-ENFORCED RATCHET CEILING: the gate fails a PR whose live count RISES above this snapshot without a matching register row + a // SAFETY: comment + a re-seed; smaller is always allowed. Deterministic and machine-independent (a source scan over committed code, not a timing). It is a COUNT/COVERAGE discipline, NOT a proof of memory safety — it bounds and documents the unsafe surface, it does not prove the absence of undefined behaviour.

memsafety.unsafe_crates.source: bench/unsafe-snapshot.json::crates (keys: sparq-core, sparq-vectors, sparq-cli, sparq-zk-compose, sparq-bench); accounting in compliance/memsafety/evidence.md MS-1
memsafety.unsafe_crates.note: Number of first-party crates that contain ANY unsafe code. Deterministic: the unsafe surface is confined to exactly these five crates; the snapshot carries a per-crate count for each, and a new unsafe block anywhere else fails to compile (forbid(unsafe_code)). Machine-independent partition of the workspace, not a measurement.

memsafety.forbid_crates.source: compliance/memsafety/evidence.md MS-1 (grep -rl 'forbid(unsafe_code)' crates/ --include='*.rs' | de-duplicated by crate); 30 of 35 workspace crates
memsafety.forbid_crates.note: Number of first-party crates carrying a crate-root #![forbid(unsafe_code)], which makes any unsafe block in that crate a COMPILE ERROR. Deterministic and machine-independent (a de-duplicated source grep over committed code). 30 forbid + 5 unsafe-bearing = 35 total workspace crates; no crate is unaccounted-for.

memsafety.total_crates.source: compliance/memsafety/evidence.md MS-1 (ls -d crates/*/ | wc -l); accounting 30 forbid + 5 unsafe = 35
memsafety.total_crates.note: Total first-party crates in the workspace. Deterministic structural count; the basis for the confinement accounting (30 forbid + 5 unsafe-bearing = 35, nothing unaccounted-for).

memsafety.unsafe_sites_core.source: bench/unsafe-snapshot.json::crates['sparq-core']; 45 register rows in compliance/memsafety/unsafe-register.md §sparq-core; enforced by scripts/unsafe-gate.py --check
memsafety.unsafe_sites_core.note: Unsafe sites in sparq-core, the single crate concentrating the storage/dictionary/mmap/parallel-scatter/SIMD unsafe (threat-model boundary B5). The largest share of the 59; ratchet-enforced per-crate. Deterministic source scan, not a measurement.
